markers.reading: Kenzo and Seeker initially return to the tavern; Seeker looks through his notes there before reconsidering.

evidence.quote: Kenzo: Yeah, I just gotta see if I go back to the tavern and hang out with Ikram and make jokes about being a drunk monk.

Kenzo: What are you doing then, Seeker?

Seeker: I'm going back to the tavern.

Seeker: Actually, when I get back to the, to the tavern, I'm looking through my notes of things and thinking, as I so often do as I get ready for sleep, about that one experience I had, and then wondering if this fountain story has anything to do with the mystery cult. Or is it just a story about a fountain?

markers.reading: Delwath and Wellby are at the oasis; Wellby will keep watch rather than meditate.

evidence.quote:
DM: So who's sleeping at the oasis? It's only Delwath going to the oasis?

Wellby: Going to be at the oasis, but not meditating.

Unknown: Okay.
DM: So, Wellby and Delwath are at the oasis. Who else? And Seeker and Kenzo are—

DM: Awesome. And Wellby, you're just gonna—you're just sort of hanging out watching them?

Wellby: Yeah, I'm going to keep watch because I want to keep—if anyone shows up, keep them from interfering. And I'm just less trusting of oases after a recent experience.

markers.reading: Seeker changes his mind, leaves the tavern, and joins the vigil on the stones by the oasis.

evidence.quote: Seeker: Because one of the reasons that I came here in the first place was to try to probe these interconnections. So maybe I will go out there and join them.

Seeker: I'm the one who ran over just to see the temple before we left out, remember? So, very true. I'll find my way back out there.

DM: Okay.

Seeker: Not exactly a practiced meditator, though.

DM: Okay, so those of you who are at the oasis, I assume you get dinner and then head out there eating something. Sure. Who's gonna—who wants to try and meditate?

Seeker: I'm just gonna do—I'm gonna, like, sit on the stones by the edge of the water and, in an effort to keep myself awake, even though I'm sitting perfectly still, you could see patterns start to appear in the stones around me, colored whorls and ridges, as I meditate on my existing knowledge of the structure of the planes.

markers.reading: Wellby leaves the oasis and finds Kenzo at the inn.

evidence.quote:
Wellby: Very good. Head off to get Kenzo.

DM: Um—

Wellby: When I find you in the inn, Kenzo, I'm like, "Candrosa found us, and he is super a dick."

Kenzo: 1030?

DM: It's like 1030.

markers.reading: The party reunites at the oasis and enters the Temple of Shakun, following Candrosa into a side room.

evidence.quote: DM: So you all sort of gather in the oasis and I—and sort of head into the—into the temple, I presume. And the first—like, the entry—Candrosa is, like, waiting in the—in the entry room of the—of the, sort of—so there's, like, this, this monastery. This building is carved into the side of this cliff of this red mesa, which is, like, towering quite a ways above you, right? Like hundreds of feet above you. But there's an area that sticks out and there's, like, a few small chambers and things like that, and there's, like, an entryway, and you can see deeper in there's—you can see there's, like, what you feel like is large open space behind you inside the mesa. But he, he sort of leads you to a little bit of a side room where there are some chairs and a table that you can sit at, and he, when he sees you all there and he sees that he, you know, clearly interrupted tonight, he does, you know, seem slightly apologetic and, you know, looks at you all and says, "I'm sorry. I didn't mean to disrupt your night like that."

route.reading: Pass through the temple entry before reaching the side room.
